name: com.unionavatars.sdk
description:
Integration of Union Avatars into Unity with UI support.

To fully understand how to work with the package, we recommend that you install the Essential Samples below and check them along with the documentation.

samples.description: Contains sample scripts, scenes and resources to fully understand how to use the package
Contains a fully featured UI to create and use avatars at runtime
Contains a sample to use Union Avatars in your VR application as well as a user interface. It requires OpenXR plugin
Contains a sample scene and scripts to load avatars as NPCs
Contains sample scripts and scenes to integrate Union Avatars with oculus lip sync. This sample requires the official Oculus Lip Sync package
